title: Page 7
slug: 仇人逼我嫁-芳妮-孟佳梨没想到当年老被她保护的小胖子竟变成眼前的帅哥总裁-他曾发誓以后换他保护她可现在欺负她最狠的就是他
content_zh:
“那天我跟父亲去孟家找人时，明明看到她站在房间的窗子前，却对我们的呼唤听而未闻。”就是那一幕，从此在他心底烙下一道无法抹灭的伤痕。

“你误会了，当日你们到我家门口时，我正在她房间里收拾一些住院所需的衣物，她那时情况紧急，已经住院治疗，等待换心了。”孟瑞泰解释。

“所以那人是你……”难怪她要他相信她，说她绝对不可能背叛他。

“后来等她手术结束，在医院休养时才知道我已经举家搬到了台北，她身体好了后曾偷偷回去找你们，却发现你们已经离开镇上不知所踪了，她还伤心了好一阵子。这个秘密一直深埋在我心中，直到我知道你父亲病危，去见过你父亲之后，才把事情的始末告诉了她，她那时才知道，原来我为了替她筹医药费治病，对你们做出如此不可饶恕的事情。”想起往事，孟瑞泰的眼中又盈满了泪水。

“你见过我爸了？”又是另一个让耿柏恩震撼的讯息。

“或许你会觉得我虚伪，但我真的一直有在打探你们家的消息，纵使没脸去见你们我也想补偿……直到我探听到你父亲癌末住院，情况不是很乐观时，就打定主意即便他要杀了我才能泄愤，我也一定要去见他一面。”

“有一天爸整晚都不说话，好像在想什么一样，心事重重，护士说下午有人去找他之后就变这样了，原来那个人是你？！”耿安茜讶异的惊呼，这才明白为何父亲那时会有这样的表现。

孟瑞泰点点头，继续道：“我知道，不管我有怎样的理由，都不该骗走你父亲的财产，背叛他对我的信任，可是、可是佳梨是我唯一的女儿，是我的命，为了救活她，即使要下地狱我也甘愿承受，不过她是无辜的，她是事后才知道这一切……柏恩，我不奢望你原谅我，但请放过佳梨吧，她不该被我的错误牵连。”孟瑞泰伸出颤抖的手在胸前合十，做出了个拜托的姿态。

“我也拜托你，撒手吧。”杨子谦跟着劝说。

面对他们的哀求，耿柏恩只想大声告诉他们，自己一直都是爱着孟佳梨的，并非如他们所想的仅仅是报复，可喉咙却像被什么紧紧掐住似的，说不出半个字。

或许，他们的缘分早该在当年就断得一干二净，这样，她也不用经历后来这些日子的痛苦煎熬。

“病人家属在吗？病人醒了。”护士的声音自病房门口传了过来，霎时打断了他们的谈话。

“我们马上过去。”杨子谦搀扶着孟瑞泰急忙上前，并请护士帮忙处理孟瑞泰额头的伤，完全将耿柏恩兄妹丢在一旁。

“哥，我们也去看看。”耿安茜没想太多，跟着就要迈步，可才踏出一步，就被耿柏恩给扯住了手臂。

“哥？”她纳闷的回头看向耿柏恩，却被他脸上死寂灰败的神色给吓了一大跳。

只见他摇摇头，随即松开手，转身朝另一个方向离去。

看着那一向高大挺拔的背影突然变得有些佝偻，充满让人窒息的庞大悲伤，她的胸口倏地紧缩，也低垂着肩膀，默默的跟在哥哥身后走着，眼泪忍不住掉了下来，为了强忍着不落泪的哥哥而流。

第10章(1)

病床上，孟佳梨缓缓睁开眼睛，一如往常几日，第一眼都是望向床边，在没梭巡到自己期待中的身影时，又会望向门口，然后把所有情绪化为一声轻叹，低垂下浓睫。

“你还在等他？”坐在床边的孟瑞泰心疼的看着女儿依然苍白的脸庞，伸出手轻轻拨开掉落她额际的发丝。

孟佳梨没有回答，可微微颤动的长睫却泄漏了她的答案——

她一直都在等。

“女儿，爸原本以为你是为了爸，所以才抱着赎罪的心情答应柏恩的逼婚，可是你告诉爸，爸是不是错得离谱了？”这几天，他们并没有讨论过关于耿柏恩的事情，一方面她的状况还不是十分稳定，他不想增加她的压力，另一方面，他也在想办法劝她放弃肚子里的生命……这实在是不可能的任务，让他始终不知道该如何开口。

他知道女儿的个性，不管她对耿伯恩是怎样的感情与感觉，要她放弃孩子，不如叫她放弃生命还比较快，所以这是个难题啊……

“爸，赎罪有很多方式，您觉得呢？”孟佳梨微微勾起唇角，扬睫望向父亲，眸光清澈平静。

孟瑞泰沉默了几秒，长叹了声，“你们从小感情就很好，如果没爸这个程咬金，或许早就顺利成婚生子，也不用经历这些困难波折。”

“爸，怎么能怪您？要怪也只能怪我的身体不争气，还要害爸为我操心，做出违背自己原则的事情，良心不安的过日子，只能说老天爷就是这样安排，没有如果。”孟佳梨伸出手安慰的拍拍父亲的手背，视线扫过了父亲额头上覆盖着伤口的纱布，鼻子发酸，忍不住心疼。

她有听杨子谦说了那天病房外的经过，虽然没当场看到，还是可以感受到当时他们彼此的情绪冲击，想必让耿柏恩十分难受吧……他根本不像他所表现出的冷血无情，相反的，他拥有最柔软的心肠，才会在报仇的矛盾中痛苦挣扎。

比起他，她其实一点都不苦，反而因为拥有他不经意的呵护而幸福的太多了。

“傻孩子，你是爸的宝贝，就算时间倒流，爸还是会毫不犹豫这么做。”虽然这样说太对不起被背叛的好友，但为了女儿，他别无选择。

“爸……”她无法去评价父亲的想法与行为，毕竟这是源自于一个父亲太深爱女儿的浓郁亲情，但不管他做了什么错事，她都愿意代他承担，无怨无悔。

“女儿，你明白爸的意思吗？”他的目光扫过女儿依然平坦的小腹，艰困的开口。

孟佳梨一凛，双手下意识的覆在了父亲目光扫过之处，消瘦的脸庞带着前所未有的坚决，声音却异常轻柔，“不行。”

“你这孩子，你明明知道自己的身体不适合怀孕。”孟瑞泰忧心忡忡的道。

“爸，您忘了我是医生？我自己的状况自己很清楚，我再好也不过了。”她噘噘嘴，流露出小女孩似的固执神态。

“正因为你是医生，你更不应该拿自己生命开玩笑，佳梨，爸不想失去你！”

孟瑞泰严肃起神色道。

“爸，正如我对您的重要性一样，我肚子里的孩子对我也是如此，您怎么能不支持我？”孟佳梨也正色反问。

“我……”孟瑞泰一时为之语塞，只能叹气摇头，“我说不过你，但这次爸无法支持你，我不赞成。”虽然她肚子里的也是他的外孙，但怎么比得过自己一手拉拔长大的女儿？

“爸——”

“不赞成什么？”杨子谦刚走进病房就隐约听到他们的对话，好奇的问。

孟瑞泰无奈的看了女儿一眼，朝杨子谦使使眼色道：“劝劝她，不管怎样都要以自己身体为重。”

杨子谦瞬间明白他们方才的争执点，表情跟着严肃了起来，“佳梨，难道你连伯父的话也不听了？”

“你们不要联合起来逼我，我不会答应的。”孟佳梨抿紧唇瓣，坚决捍卫自己的宝宝。

“那……如果连耿伯恩都不要这个孩子呢？”杨子谦带着点担忧的观察着她的反应。

孟佳梨原本就苍白的脸庞似乎又更加的雪白了些，“他说了什么？”这么多天都等不到他的身影，她其实早有心理准备。
content_en:
"That day when my father and I went to the Meng family to look for someone, we clearly saw her standing in front of the window of the room, but she ignored our calls." That scene left an indelible scar in his heart.

"You misunderstood. When you arrived at my door that day, I was packing some clothes needed for hospitalization in her room. She was in emergency condition at that time and had been hospitalized for treatment, waiting for a heart transplant." Meng Ruitai explained.

"So that person is you..." No wonder she wanted him to believe her, saying that there was absolutely no way she would betray him.

"Later, when she was recuperating in the hospital after the operation, she found out that I had moved my family to Taipei. After she recovered, she secretly went back to look for you, only to find that you had left town and were missing. She was sad for a while. This secret has been buried deep in my heart untilIt was only after I knew that your father was critically ill and went to see your father that I told her the whole story.Only then did she realize that I had done such an unforgivable thing to you in order to raise medical expenses for her." Thinking of the past, Meng Ruitai's eyes filled with tears again.

"Have you met my dad?" This was another message that shocked Bowen.

"Maybe you think I'm hypocritical, but I have really been inquiring about your family. Even if I have no face to see you, I still want to make up for it... Until I found out that your father was hospitalized with terminal cancer and the situation was not very optimistic, I made up my mind that even if he had to kill me to vent his anger, I would definitely go and see him."

"One day my father didn't talk all night, as if he was thinking about something, and he was very worried. The nurse said that someone came to see him in the afternoon and he changed like this. It turned out that person was you?!" Geng Anqian exclaimed in surprise, and then she understood why her father behaved like this at that time.

Meng Ruitai nodded and continued: "I know that no matter what reasons I have, I should not defraud your father of his property and betray his trust in me. But, Jia Li is my only daughter and my life. In order to save her, I will go to hell even if I have to.She is willing to bear it, but she is innocent, and she only knew all this after the fact...Born, I don't expect you to forgive me, but please let Jia Li go, she shouldn't be implicated in my mistakes." Meng Ruitai stretched out his trembling hands and clasped his hands in front of his chest, making a gesture of begging.

"I beg you, please let go." Yang Ziqian persuaded him.

Faced with their pleading, Geng Bo'en just wanted to tell them loudly that he had always loved Meng Jiali, and it was not just revenge as they thought, but his throat seemed to be tightly strangled by something, and he could not say a word.

Perhaps, their fate should have been broken long ago, so that she would not have to go through the pain and suffering in the following days.

"Are the patient's family members here? The patient is awake." The nurse's voice came from the door of the ward, instantly interrupting their conversation.

"We'll go there right away." Yang Ziqian supported Meng Ruitai and hurried forward, and asked the nurse to help treat the injury on Meng Ruitai's forehead, completely leaving the Geng Boen brothers and sisters aside.

"Brother, let's go take a look too." Geng Anxi didn't think too much and was about to take a step, but as soon as she took a step, Geng Bo'en grabbed her arm.

"Brother?" She turned back to look at Geng Bo'en in confusion, but was shocked by the lifeless and defeated look on his face.

He shook his head, then let go of his hand, turned around and left in the other direction.

Seeing that the always tall and straight back suddenly became a little rickety, full of suffocating sadness, her chest tightened suddenly, her shoulders drooped, and she walked silently behind her brother. Her tears couldn't help but fall, for her brother who was trying not to cry.

Chapter 10(1)

On the hospital bed, Meng Jiali slowly opened her eyes. As usual, her first glance was towards the bedside. When she saw the figure she was expecting, she would look towards the door again. Then she turned all her emotions into a sigh and lowered her thick eyelashes.

"Are you still waiting for him?" Meng Ruitai, who was sitting by the bed, looked at her daughter's still pale face distressedly, and reached out his hand to gently brush away the hair that fell from her forehead.

Meng Jiali did not answer, but her long eyelashes trembling slightly revealed her answer——

She has been waiting.

"Daughter, Dad originally thought that you were doing it for Dad, so you agreed to Burn's forced marriage in a mood of atonement, but tell Dad, is Dad terribly wrong?" In the past few days, they have not discussed matters about Gunn. On the one hand, her condition is not very stable, and he does not want to increase her pressure. On the other hand, he is also trying to persuade her to give up the life in her belly... This is really an impossible task, and he still doesn't know how to speak.

He knew his daughter's personality. No matter what her feelings were towards Gunn, it would be quicker to ask her to give up her child than to give up her life, so this was a difficult problem...

"Dad, there are many ways to atone for sins, what do you think?" Meng Jiali raised the corners of her lips slightly, raised her eyelashes and looked at her father, her eyes clear and calm.

Meng Ruitai was silent for a few seconds, and then sighed, "You have been on good terms since childhood. If you didn't have Cheng Yaojin as your father, you might have successfully gotten married and had children long ago, and you wouldn't have to go through these difficulties and twists and turns."

"Dad, how can I blame you? If I want to blame, I can only blame my health for not living up to expectations. I also want to make dad worry about me, do things that go against his own principles, and live a life with uneasy conscience. I can only say that this is how God arranged it. There are no ifs." Meng Jiali stretched out her hand and patted the back of her father's hand comfortingly. Her eyes swept over the gauze covering the wound on her father's forehead. Her nose was sore and she couldn't help but feel distressed.

She heard Yang Ziqian talk about what happened outside the ward that day. Although she didn't see it on the spot, she could still feel the emotional impact between them at that time. It must have made Geng Bo'en very uncomfortable... He was not at all as cold-blooded and ruthless as he showed. On the contrary, he had the softest heart, and he struggled painfully with the contradiction of revenge.

Compared to him, she was not suffering at all. Instead, she was so happy because of his careless care.

"Silly boy, you are dad's baby. Even if time goes back, dad will still do this without hesitation." Although saying this was very sorry for his betrayed friend, he had no choice for the sake of his daughter.

"Dad..." She couldn't evaluate her father's thoughts and actions. After all, it came from the strong affection of a father who loved his daughter too deeply. But no matter what wrong he did, she was willing to bear it on his behalf without any regrets.

"Daughter, do you understand what dad means?" He glanced at his daughter's still flat belly and spoke with difficulty.

Meng Jiali shuddered, and her hands subconsciously covered the place where her father glanced. Her thin face showed unprecedented determination, but her voice was unusually soft, "No."

"You child, you clearly know that your body is not suitable for pregnancy." Meng Ruitai said worriedly.

"Dad, have you forgotten that I'm a doctor? I know my own situation very well, and I couldn't be better." She pouted, showing a stubborn look like a little girl.

"Just because you are a doctor, you shouldn't make fun of your own life, Jiali, Dad doesn't want to lose you!"

Meng Ruitai said with a serious expression.

"Dad, just as I am important to you, the child in my belly is also important to me. How can you not support me?" Meng Jiali also asked sternly.

"I..." Meng Ruitai was speechless for a moment, and could only sigh and shake her head, "I can't help you, but dad can't support you this time, and I don't agree with it." Although she was carrying his grandson in her belly, how could it compare to the daughter she had raised and grown up with her own hands?

"Dad——"

"What do you disapprove of?" Yang Ziqian vaguely heard their conversation as soon as he walked into the ward and asked curiously.

Meng Ruitai glanced at her daughter helplessly, winked at Yang Ziqian and said, "Encourage her to put her own body first no matter what."

Yang Ziqian instantly understood the point of their dispute, and his expression became serious, "Jia Li, don't you even listen to my uncle's words?"

"Don't unite to force me, I won't agree." Meng Jiali pursed her lips and resolutely defended her baby.

"Then... what if even Geng Boer doesn't want this child?" Yang Ziqian watched her reaction with some worry.

Meng Jiali's already pale face seemed to have turned even whiter, "What did he say?" She had been mentally prepared for not being able to see him for so many days.
